title: Better terracotta names
description: This texture pack adds better names for terracotta blocks
body:
This resource pack adds new, better names for misnamed terracotta blocks.

Names changed:
- **Gray** terracotta: **Grayish brown** terracotta
- **Light gray** terracotta: **Light brown** terracotta
- **Black** terracotta: **Dark brown** terracotta
- **Purple** terracotta: **Plum** terracotta
- **Light blue** terracotta: **Sky blue** terracotta
- **Blue** terracotta: **Purple** terracotta
- **Cyan** terracotta: **Gray** terracotta
- **Pink** terracotta: **Magenta** terracotta
- **Magenta** terracotta: **Pink** terracotta

![Blocks changed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/625b0bd7cc43c2e1b4b80fe41c840d037bfdb231.png)
